title: feat(reload): add a reload method on the InstantSearch component
body:
**Summary**
Give the ability to the user to clear the cached answers from Algolia.
(see #1050)

**Result**
The user can now clear the cache by calling `clearCache()` on his/her `search` instance.
See the results in the `RefreshCache` story on dev-novel (network tab).

comments.body:
Deploy preview ready!

Built with commit fab4c3e9f9514157cd314ce56d4d1a3a7e0df5ba

https://deploy-preview-2637--algolia-instantsearch.netlify.com

> looks great, what about calling it refresh instead of clearCache?

As a parallel with the browser, `refresh` or `reload` could be more intuitive because what you want when you clear the cache is to reload the result with fresh ones.
It's all good for me. Thanks @marielaures 💯
